title: Time Jump — 07:30

fields.narration: Facilitator: It is now 07:30. The problem has spread to the Student Information System, file shares, and the Tyler Munis payroll system. Ransomware has encrypted on-premises data, and a ransom note now appears on staff laptops. The 05:00 offline roster is now the only trusted source for student accountability. The EOC has not been activated yet, but the threat of systemic failure is imminent.
worldState: The EOC has not been activated yet, but the threat of systemic failure is imminent.
Ransomware has encrypted on-premises data including HUSD-FS02, HUSD-ERP01, and HUSD-SIS.
A ransom note now appears on staff laptops, displaying the message: 'Halverson Unified School District data is encrypted. Pay $2.8M in Bitcoin to restore. No contact with law enforcement.'
The 05:00 paper attendance roster (HUSD-ATT-2026-0500) is the only trusted source for student accountability.
The SIS, file shares, and payroll system are now non-functional.
The system integrity of HUSD-FS02, HUSD-ERP01, and HUSD-SIS has been compromised.
fields.facilitatorNote: This is a critical time jump to trigger EOC activation. Watch for the Incident Commander to declare a cyber incident and for the Technical Lead to initiate containment. Ensure the EOC is formally activated and roles begin to act under the EOP.
fields.scenarioTitle: Digital Lockdown — Cyber Incident & School Continuity

instructorNote: This time jump triggers full EOC activation. The Incident Commander must declare a cyber incident and initiate formal containment. Watch for legal, communications, and technical roles to engage.
